enforcementNote: Outside audit mode the hook blocks only secret file reads and edits to the Hullproof hook files; in audit mode it denies file write tools and shell commands outside a short read only list, but it does not check file reads and Google does not say what Antigravity does if the hook fails to run.
trustNote: Open the project folder as your workspace and choose trust if Antigravity asks.
firstRun: mkdir -p docs/security && touch docs/security/.audit-mode, then run: agy -p "Use the hullproof-audit skill to audit this project."
